title: DeltaCata guides methyltransferase engineering with improved catalytic efficiency in vitro
summary: The accepted-paper abstract reports that DeltaCata, a geometric graph neural network predicting mutation effects on enzyme kinetics, guided engineering of methyltransferase sGmOMT2. The authors report up to a sevenfold improvement in catalytic efficiency for in vitro icaritin synthesis. This experimental application goes beyond the model benchmarks; industrial-scale performance is not demonstrated by the reviewed abstract.
ai_technology: DeltaCata; Siamese geometric graph neural network
organization: Sun Yat-sen University; National Supercomputing Center in Shenzhen

evidence.tested: The abstract reports experimental enzyme engineering and an in vitro catalytic-efficiency improvement.
evidence.unknown: Full experimental methods, industrial performance and independent replication were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: The model predicts mutation-induced kinetic changes to prioritize enzyme variants.
